candidates.title: Consumer_behavior
candidates.summary: Consumer_behavior: A small number of platforms capture the lion’s share of user time and app/game revenue is highly concentrated.

source_metadata.evidence: Finding: 'A small number of properties and platforms capture the lion’s share of user time online.' (complemented by app-economy evidence showing top games take ~25% of global app revenue).
Finding: 'Cord-cutting will not mirror past tech transitions; pay TV and studio-produced content remain dominant, and binge-watching is widespread,' explaining why rapid cord-cutting is unlikely.
Finding: 'Streaming audio accounts for over a third of listening time but under one-fifth of total industry revenue (U.S. digital revenue ~$4.5B vs total ~$14.9B).'
Report headline and table-of-contents headline: 'THE AVERAGE AMERICAN SPENDS MORE TIME ON TECH & MEDIA THAN WORK OR SLEEP.'
Section headline: 'MESSAGING WILL BLOW PAST SOCIAL NETWORKS AS THE DOMINANT MEDIA ACTIVITY' and related analysis of messaging penetration and platform monetization.
We can find growth opportunities in people’s online behavior: how many users visit the top websites and apps, and for how long? A few properties and platforms capture the lion’s share of user time.
Time spent on major digital activities like video, audio, social media and gaming will continue to increase. CAGR: VIDEO 4.5%, SOCIAL MEDIA 17.8%, AUDIO 4.9%, GAMING 11.9%.
In Asia-Pacific, local messaging apps dominate in the largest countries, but in Southeast Asia global players are competing. Penetration by Country, Local vs. Global Messengers.
Top 5 Channels... 165 Million (≈11M per channel) subscribers; 47 Billion (~3B+ per channel) video views; 2015E Growth: +20% subscribers, +30% average view, +40% video views.

Growth in tournament prize pools - which are largely crowdfunded by fans - illustrates potential of eSports. Dota 2 Example: Growth in Tournament Prize Pool, $M (2012–2015) ... 126% CAGR. Organized multiplayer video game competitions are emerging as a formidable spectator sport.

If television cable cutting followed the same pattern as telephones, the crossover would happen in 2019—but this isn’t likely. Most Americans now binge watch TV, amplifying time-shifted viewing; percentage of people who binge by age group shows Millennials highest. People are still spending most of their time with TV- and studio-produced content.

Expect growth to come from digital players claiming their fair share of the pie. TOTAL U.S. DIGITAL REVENUE $4.5B. Digital takes up over a third of listening time, but less than a fifth of total revenue (Consumer and Advertising Spend on Music Listening, U.S., 2014 ($14.9B)).
The top 10 games take 25% of the $23 Billion in global app revenue... Over 25% of global revenue ($6B) generated by Top 10 game apps.
Enterprise is also starting to move to app-enabled messaging with bot integrations. LAYER #2 - APPS & BOTS ... 1.1m Daily Active Users, 300k Paying Users.
